mobbin:f8f82b62-60bc-404c-a1c1-af41afce5.summary: From Spend reimbursements the user opens 'Upload receipts', watches upload then AI matching, reviews vendor and amount, and chooses 'Card expense' or 'Reimbursement' (or Delete or Skip).
steps: Spend reimbursements list with add button
Match panel: Card expense or Reimbursement
steal: While Uploading and Matching, the screen says you can 'upload more while they match', so a batch can keep going (screens 3–4).
A 'Matching…' sparkle on the file row makes the AI wait visible before results (screen 4).
A ready-to-review card shows vendor, date, amount, and thumbnail so you can glance-check automatic text reading from a photo or scan (OCR) before deep edit (screen 5).
The match panel offers primary and secondary destinations plus Delete and Skip for unmatched or wrong extracts (screen 6).
avoid: The 'Card expense' vs 'Reimbursement' fork is spend-ledger routing; inventory needs match-to-shelf, create-item, or flag-shortage, not payment buckets (screen 6).
mobbin:f8f82b62-60bc-404c-a1c1-af41afce5.fit: Inventory: maps to AI equipment analysis as upload a list, extract with AI, review, then match or route unmatched rows; receipt-to-expense becomes list-to-shelf match and shortages.

mobbin:30099a43-f093-441a-b868-b6a69e2da.summary: From empty Bills the user opens 'Add new bill', drops an invoice, waits through 'Extracting bill details', edits lines with 'Match with PO', comments, submits, and lands on statused Bills.
steps: Spend home with Bills and Expenses
Bills empty table with New bill
Add bill dropzone and empty form
Split view with filled header fields
Line items with Match with PO
Bills list success message and statuses
steal: Source PDF on the left and structured form on the right lets you verify the extract while editing (screens 5–8).
The 'Extracting…' pop-up says 'up to a minute', so the AI wait is honest without freezing the form (screen 4).
'Match with PO' on each extracted line links parsed text to an existing catalog or purchase order (screens 6–7).
Draft, Pending approval, and Overdue on the table after submit show the lifecycle after an AI create (screen 9).
avoid: The marketing Spend home and accounting-connect promos add noise before the extract and match work (screen 1).
mobbin:30099a43-f093-441a-b868-b6a69e2da.fit: Inventory: nearby pattern for AI equipment analysis: upload a scenario list, extract lines, match each to the shelf or catalog, then save a draft or flag gaps. Overdue also models late returns.
